newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon Sales seen posting record profit - paper.
newsitem.headline: Canon Sales seen posting record profit - paper.

text.p: Canon Sales Co Inc is expected to post a parent current profit of about 22 billion yen in the year to December 31, 1996, its largest ever, a Japanese economic daily said on Friday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that the upward trend was likely to continue and that the company's current profit in 1997 would grow to about 25 billion yen.
The forecast was based on an expected rise in sales of personal computers (PCs) and printers for PCs, the paper said.
The company's actual parent current profit in 1995 was 15.46 billion yen.

The paper said that Canon Sales would implement a share split and to pay a larger dividend this year to return profit to shareholders. It was likely to take similar steps in 1997 as well, the paper said.
Officials at Canon Sales were not immediately available for comment.
